decision_skill.name: validated_seasonal_ensemble
decision_skill.description: Combine frequency-informed seasonal forecasts only when recent causal validation supports their persistence, using averaging to reduce model-specific failure risk.
decision_skill.applicability: When a time series may contain repeating phase structure and multiple plausible seasonal or baseline forecasts can be evaluated on recent pre-forecast observations.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Generate candidate seasonal lags from the observed frequency structure, compare them with robust nonseasonal baselines across several recent causal forecast origins, retain only candidates with stable validation advantage, and blend the retained forecasts with conservative weights and damped level change.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when seasonal candidates lack a consistent recent out-of-sample advantage, validation blocks are too sparse or noncausal, the apparent cycle is driven by isolated outliers, or a structural break makes past phase behavior unreliable.
